design_rule: Profile membership is not stored as a new Decision Record field. Activation is determined by governance context and passed to validation as external implementation context. Profile activation never creates a new architecture construct.

A.name: Authorization Change
A.activation: A material condition results in or may require a change to existing authorization.

conditional_requirements.when: authorization state materially changes
trigger timing is material to authorization, consequence, accountability, or reconstruction
authority changed at a materially different time from trigger detection or decision time
corrective or remedial action exists or is required
determination is conditional, temporary, time-bounded, evidence-limited, remediation-dependent, transition-dependent, or otherwise subject to future reassessment

B.name: Delegation / Multi-Agent Execution
B.activation: Material consequential execution involves delegated authority, spawned execution, multiple agents, branches, merges, downstream services, or independently authorized actors.

conditional_requirements.when: authority originates from a materially distinct source or provenance must be reconstructed
material consequential execution involves delegation or independently authorized downstream actors
instance-level attribution is material
material transformation or handoff affects evidence, authority, downstream reliance, decision, execution, consequence, or accountability
spawned, delegated, branched, or hierarchical execution materially affects authority, provenance, accountability, or consequence
permission, credential, or tool authority materially affects consequential execution or authorization
downstream acceptance or execution materially affects consequence, provenance, or accountability
consequential execution must remain linked to the governing determination

C.name: Consequential Execution
C.activation: AI execution creates or materially contributes to consequential digital, operational, financial, legal, physical, safety, or equivalent external effect requiring governance reconstruction.

conditional_requirements.when: instance-level attribution is material
version/configuration is material
environment/external state materially affects authorization, safety, evidence, transition, or consequence
execution creates a material externally committed consequence requiring governance reconstruction
permission, credential, or tool authority materially affects consequential execution or authorization

D.name: Physical AI
D.activation: Physical AI perception, decision, control, or actuation is material to the governance determination.

conditional_requirements.when: instance-level attribution is material
version/configuration is material
environment/external state materially affects authorization, safety, evidence, transition, or consequence
consequential execution must remain linked to the governing determination
execution creates a material externally committed consequence
corrective/remedial action exists or is required
restart or resumption is under governance review
future reassessment is required

D.guardrail: Do not activate direct-actuation controls solely because AI processes physical-world information.

E.name: Transition
E.activation: The governed subject crosses a boundary requiring Transition Authorization.

conditional_requirements.when: environment/external state is material
version/configuration is material
future reassessment is required

E.note: record.evidence_sufficiency is canonical core and therefore always present.

F.name: Incident / Recovery / Restart
F.activation: A material incident, anomaly, suspension, safe-state event, corrective action, recovery, restart, or resumption requires an attributable governance determination.

conditional_requirements.when: trigger timing is material
authorization state materially changes
authority change effective time materially differs
corrective/remedial action exists or is required
restart or resumption is under governance review
instance-level attribution is material
version/configuration is material
crossing a governed boundary requires Transition Authorization
future reassessment is required

F.note: record.evidence_sufficiency is canonical core and therefore always present.

G.name: Shared-Responsibility Deployment
G.activation: Material governance responsibility or evidence dependency is divided across organizations, providers, customers, operators, or other accountable parties.

conditional_requirements.when: authority originates from a materially distinct source or provenance must be reconstructed
delegation/downstream authority is material
evidence-sufficiency authority is materially distinct from accountable authority
version/configuration is material
externally governable instructions/context are material
future reassessment is required

G.note: record.evidence_refs is canonical core. Contractual and procurement evidence remains external and is referenced.
